activities.activity: Review Sterile Structure Containment architecture allocation
activities.rationale: Confirm the module has a coherent purpose, submodule breakdown, interfaces and component allocation before any procurement work.
acceptanceCriteria: Every submodule has a stated purpose and at least one component candidate.
Interfaces named on the module are carried by the responsible submodule where the design depends on that interface.
No blocker or major architecture issue is attached to the module.

activities.activity: Verify Sterile Structure Containment requirement calculations
activities.rationale: Tie parsed brief requirements to explicit engineering calculations or sanity checks before accepting the design envelope.
acceptanceCriteria: Each linked requirement has a calculation, sanity check or clearly stated deferred validation path.
No linked sanity check is failing.
Warnings have named follow-up calculations or test evidence.

activities.activity: Collect source-backed evidence for Sterile Structure Containment critical components
activities.rationale: Critical component candidates may support architecture review, but BoM cost/manufacturer/MPN claims are blocked until source-backed evidence is admitted.
acceptanceCriteria: Supplier name, manufacturer or equivalent, MPN where applicable, unit cost and source URL/reference are present.
Evidence is explicitly retrieved and admissible under the sourcing admission protocol.
Claimed quantity and component identity match the architecture candidate line.

activities.moduleName: Sterile Structure Containment -> Media Gas And Harvest Transport
activities.activity: Verify sterile_fluid_path interface contract
activities.rationale: The sterile bag must connect to feed, harvest and sampling fluid paths.
acceptanceCriteria: Both endpoint modules declare the interface.
At least one submodule carrier is named on each endpoint.
Electrical, thermal, fluid, mechanical or data capacity is validated by the next detailed design pass.

activities.moduleName: Mixing And Agitation -> Sterile Structure Containment
activities.activity: Verify sterile_boundary interface contract
activities.rationale: Mixing drive must couple into the disposable culture boundary without breaking sterility.
acceptanceCriteria: Both endpoint modules declare the interface.
At least one submodule carrier is named on each endpoint.
Electrical, thermal, fluid, mechanical or data capacity is validated by the next detailed design pass.

activities.moduleName: Media Gas And Harvest Transport -> Thermal Gas Exhaust Interface
activities.activity: Verify gas_path interface contract
activities.rationale: Sparging and exhaust conditioning must share a declared gas path.
acceptanceCriteria: Both endpoint modules declare the interface.
At least one submodule carrier is named on each endpoint.
Electrical, thermal, fluid, mechanical or data capacity is validated by the next detailed design pass.

activities.moduleName: Process Sensing Instrumentation -> Control Compute Communication
activities.activity: Verify sensor_bus interface contract
activities.rationale: DO, pH, mass and temperature measurements must feed process control.
acceptanceCriteria: Both endpoint modules declare the interface.
At least one submodule carrier is named on each endpoint.
Electrical, thermal, fluid, mechanical or data capacity is validated by the next detailed design pass.

activities.moduleName: Control Compute Communication -> Media Gas And Harvest Transport
activities.activity: Verify pump_control interface contract
activities.rationale: Controller must command feed, harvest and gas-flow actuators.
acceptanceCriteria: Both endpoint modules declare the interface.

Electrical, thermal, fluid, mechanical or data capacity is validated by the next detailed design pass.

activities.moduleName: Aseptic And Pressure Safety -> Sterile Structure Containment
activities.activity: Verify pressure_relief interface contract
activities.rationale: Disposable culture containment must connect to pressure relief and sterile exhaust protection.
acceptanceCriteria: Both endpoint modules declare the interface.

Electrical, thermal, fluid, mechanical or data capacity is validated by the next detailed design pass.

activities.activity: Review risk control for Loss of sterility through connector or bag handling
activities.rationale: Provisional RPN 180; mitigation: Closed sterile connectors, pre-use integrity checks and operator setup checklist.
acceptanceCriteria: Severity, occurrence and detection ratings have been reviewed by a domain owner.
Mitigation is accepted, corrected or converted into a design action.
Any residual high-risk item has an owner before publication.
blockers: Risk evidence not yet reviewed in scratch prototype.

activities.activity: Review risk control for Cell culture loss from DO or pH control failure
activities.rationale: Provisional RPN 128; mitigation: Redundant alarming, sensor calibration and conservative gas/feed control limits.
acceptanceCriteria: Severity, occurrence and detection ratings have been reviewed by a domain owner.
Mitigation is accepted, corrected or converted into a design action.
Any residual high-risk item has an owner before publication.
blockers: Risk evidence not yet reviewed in scratch prototype.

activities.activity: Review risk control for Disposable bag overpressure

acceptanceCriteria: Severity, occurrence and detection ratings have been reviewed by a domain owner.
